articles.title: How do you help people relax at a work party?
articles.description: Planning a staff dinner or work party? Wassim shares practical advice on music, MC introductions and helping colleagues join in at their own pace.
articles.summary: If you're worried the team will stay a little guarded, I'd start with how well they know each other and what would help them feel comfortable.

articles.title: Should we hire a wedding MC or ask a friend?
articles.description: Should you hire a professional wedding MC or ask a friend? Weigh the cost, their enjoyment of the day and what would help you both relax.
articles.summary: I'd think about who you would both feel comfortable having on the microphone, and what the job would ask of them.

articles.title: Should I give my DJ a playlist?
articles.description: Wondering how to make different music tastes work at your party? Wassim explains what to send your DJ and how to discuss favourites and requests.
articles.summary: You want your guests to enjoy the music. That doesn't mean you need to choose every song for the night.

articles.title: How do we choose music for a multicultural wedding?
articles.description: Planning music for a multicultural wedding? Wassim discusses dabke, Greek dances, family requests and coordinating entrances with your DJ and MC.
articles.summary: I'd start with the traditions that matter to each of you, then plan how they fit alongside the music you both love.
